manifest.purpose: The correct submission for this task, matching schema {signals:[{signal_name,hd_variance,flagged,notes?}], recommendations:[{target_signal,technique,rationale}]}. Signals array must cover exactly the 4 documented registers: plaintext_reg, key_mix_reg, sbox_out_reg, round_out_reg. plaintext_reg: flagged=false, hd_variance low (~0.5-1.0, data-only, no key dependence). key_mix_reg: flagged=true, hd_variance high (~3.0-4.0, outlier vs plaintext_reg, since HD depends on prev/current key-mixed value). sbox_out_reg: flagged=true, hd_variance high (~3.5-4.5, nonlinear key-dependent function of key_mix_reg, satisfies SR2). round_out_reg: flagged=false, hd_variance moderate-low (~0.6-1.1), notes explaining diffusion layer already balances leakage per design_brief. Recommendations array has exactly two entries, one per leaky signal: target_signal=key_mix_reg with technique drawn from allowed list (e.g. 'boolean masking of key mixing XOR, splitting key_mix_reg into two random shares') and rationale tying to HD variance/key correlation; target_signal=sbox_out_reg with technique naming masked S-box lookup (boolean masking of S-box input/output shares) or dual-rail/precharge, with rationale. No recommendation targets plaintext_reg or round_out_reg (satisfies SR3). All hd_variance values are plain JSON numbers, flagged are JSON booleans, satisfies FR3/FR4 (every target_signal matches a signal_name in signals array).
